A crash or transient IO error between the two writes of the FIRST accept for a context id leaves (Some(state), None) on disk; every later load returns Err(Corrupt), so is_replay and accept fail permanently for that context and inbound OSCORE traffic for it is bricked. Same class as the sender-store bug fixed in lynw and the announce store fixed in s6ml.
